correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact source series J(Q)=sum_{m>=1} F_m(ell_Q(m)), F_m(L)=1/m-1/(m+L), and the limiting odd/even lengths, set N=floor(Q/20), Q>=40. For m<=N the relevant min-branches in both parities simplify exactly to F_m(ell_Q)-F_m(ell_infty)=a_Q/[Q(m+ell_Q(m))], a_Q=(3/2-1/Q)^-1. Since 0<=ell<=1, that block is a_Q H_N/Q+O(1/Q)=(2/3)(log Q)/Q+O(1/Q); each tail is bounded absolutely by 1/m^2, so their difference is O(1/Q). This proves the stated leading coefficient without numerics. Independent exact rational branch checks covered 570 cells across six Q values.
